title: WHERE Before GROUP BY
flavorText: WHERE runs before GROUP BY — it narrows down which rows participate in each group. HAVING runs after.
narrative: Count products per category, but only consider products priced above 20. This filters rows first, then groups.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Datapad','Electronics',299.99,45),(2,'Power Cell','Electronics',19.99,200),(3,'Steel Cable','Hardware',8.50,500),(4,'Logic Board','Electronics',89.99,30),(5,'Ceramic Fuse','Hardware',2.25,1000),(6,'Optic Lens','Optics',149.99,15),(7,'Servo Motor','Robotics',55.00,80),(8,'Pressure Valve','Hardware',12.75,300);
task: Count products per category where price > 20. Order by category alphabetically.

hints.text: Add WHERE price > 20 before GROUP BY to filter rows before grouping.
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE price > 20 GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE price > 20 GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;
